claim: The locked benchmark contains 264 evidence families and 2112 items; Track R has 1584 items and Track I has 528.
boundary: Construction claim only; not model performance.

claim: All 29 locked benchmark validity gates pass.
boundary: Engineering and measurement checks do not establish model ability.

claim: Llama-3.2-3B shows a positive P-R difference on Track R in interface B.
metric: Track R domain-macro accuracy: P=.5014 R=.4534 delta=.0480 CI95=[.0187,.0813]
boundary: Does not extend to Track I or prove understanding.

claim: Gemma-2-2B shows a positive P-R difference on Track R in controlled readout A but not in supervised QA B.
boundary: Same benchmark but different trained heads; no causal mechanism claim.

claim: Llama-3.1-8B has opposite Track R P-R directions in A and B on the same locked sample.
boundary: Interface separation; B FCJS=0 for P and R.

claim: Qwen3-8B-Base does not show a general positive P-R item-accuracy difference in A or B.
metric: A Track R delta=-.0249 CI crosses 0; B Track R delta=-.0110 CI crosses 0
boundary: A non-detection is not evidence that representations contain no temporal information.

claim: Native free generation and constrained choice scoring differ materially and must be reported separately.
metric: VOR and Track R domain-macro accuracy
boundary: Constrained scoring uses candidate likelihoods; it is not free generation.

claim: Gemma-2-9B and DeepSeek-V2-Lite free generation yield zero strictly parseable outputs under the locked parser.
boundary: Output-interface failure; do not call this zero temporal ability.

claim: Pretraining effects are selective across models tasks and interfaces rather than universally positive.
metric: paired P-R domain-macro deltas and 2,000-draw group-cluster CI
boundary: Complete locked matrix supports selectivity, not a universal positive pretraining effect or shared causal mechanism.

claim: Gemma-2-9B controlled readout shows a positive P-R difference on Track I and target-update success, while Track R CI crosses zero.
metric: Track I delta=.1687 CI95=[.0762,.2671]; TUS delta=.1722 CI95=[.0919,.2622]; Track R delta=.0283 CI crosses 0
boundary: Controlled linear readout result; the separate B result is reported in C12.

claim: Mistral-7B-v0.3 controlled readout shows a positive P-R difference for TUS but not for item-level Track R/I accuracy.
metric: TUS delta=.1540 CI95=[.0538,.2559]; Track R/I accuracy CIs cross 0
boundary: Behavioral joint metric is selective; not a general model-level gain.

claim: Gemma-2-9B has opposite significant Track I P-R directions in controlled readout A and supervised QA B on the same locked sample.
boundary: Interface-specific head behavior; no causal claim.

claim: Mistral-7B-v0.3 shows a positive P-R TUS difference in controlled readout A but not in supervised QA B.
boundary: Behavioral metric separation; item-accuracy CIs cross zero in both interfaces.
